rationale: Official Broadcom documentation describes CA Performance Management/DX NetOps as network monitoring, analysis and predictive analytics/projections. Nothing in inspected documentation establishes AI/ML; forecasting/prediction labels alone are not sufficient. Functional documentation supports conventional network monitoring, but current successor version is not fully applicable historically.
version_scope: No release/date in source record. Official Broadcom 25.4 DX NetOps Performance Management docs treated as product successor; cannot establish every historical version's exact feature scope.
issues: Unversioned legacy product compared with current 25.4 successor documentation; analytics/prediction claim not independently established as non-AI in historical version.

sources.excerpt: DX NetOps Performance Management monitors, stores, analyzes, and displays information for assuring service quality across large, complex, multi-technology, multi-vendor network infrastructure. Key features include intelligent analytics, customizable dashboards, and predictive analytics; configurable and dynamic projections provide insight into capacity planning.
sources.applicability: Official successor documentation directly describes CA PM network-management functionality, but does not identify AI/ML or establish historical applicability.
